what_i_see: A classic three-sphere snowman with progressively smaller white spheres stacked vertically. An orange cone carrot nose sits on top of the head. A dark stick arm extends from the left side of the middle body. A small dark dot on the right side of the head suggests an eye or button. Clean rendering with good proportions and a dark background that makes the white snowman pop. Missing some details like a hat, scarf, eyes, mouth, or second arm that would elevate it further.
